_comment: Hand-maintained capability-tier map for tierVariance (opencode-plugin/src/bench/leaderboard.ts). Keys are HF leaderboard submission ids (agent__model, matching matrix.json's per-task sub keys); values are 'frontier' | 'mid' | 'small'. Only the 10 submissions we already have a reference matrix for (matrix-10agent.json) are mapped so far -- extend this as the full 76-submission sweep lands more subs into matrix.json. No 'small' entries yet among the known 10 (that tier is for smaller open-weight models like the qwen3.x-9b / minimax-m2 class submissions visible in the raw HF tree but not yet pulled) -- tierVariance simply treats an unmapped sub as excluded from tier grouping, so leaving it sparse is safe.
